title: tree-layer entry per SPEC_tree_layers_v1
description: Validates a single tree-layer entry within an atlas's layers.registry.json. Tree-layers declare a directory of artifacts (vs the existing scalar layer family which declares one URL). See atlas-core/docs/SPEC_tree_layers_v1.md for the full specification.

layer_id.description: Stable slug. Unique within the atlas's layers.registry.json. Allows mixed case so established bioinformatics conventions (passA, passB, etc.) round-trip; cohort_ids stay strict-lowercase (cohorts.schema.json) because they're a smaller, curated set.

kind.description: Discriminator. Always 'tree' for tree-layers; scalar layers omit this field.

version.description: Per-layer version. Independent of the tree_layer SCHEMA version.

cohort_id.description: Cohort this layer's data belongs to. Cross-validated against cohorts.registry.json.

produced_by.description: workflow_id (from workflows.registry.json) that emits this tree. Tree-layer staleness is the workflow's status.

root.description: Root directory path (relative to atlas root) for the tree.

tree.description: Tree structure. Keys are child names, values are nodes ({dir} or {leaf}).

leaf_kind.description: Canonical leaf parsers registered with the resolver. SPEC §5 lists the parsing semantics. New kinds require resolver work, not just schema additions.
